title: VLMs Read Aloud: The Gap Between Recognizing and Using Visual Text
abstract: arXiv:2611.01517v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual-text compression renders long contexts as images and is engineered around how much of the text a vision-language model (VLM) can recover. Yet recovered text is not usable text. VLMs can transcribe the text in an image word for word and still fail to answer from it; given back their own transcript, they answer nearly as well as from the original text. We call this difference the read-use gap. Recognizing and using visual text have different resolution requirements: Qwen3-VL-8B's recognition saturates at 15-pixel characters while use catches up only at 24 pixels, and scaling from 2B to 32B raises recognition without narrowing the gap. Putting the evidence into words closes it: thinking VLMs recite the evidence in their thinking, and their own transcript, written without seeing the question, recovers most of what thinking adds. In a preregistered held-out test, the gap ranks how much eight VLMs gain from their own words over pixels

translated_title: VLMs 朗读出来：识别与使用视觉文本之间的差距
translated_abstract: 视觉文本压缩将长上下文渲染成图像，其工程设计围绕视觉语言模型（VLM）能从图像中恢复多少文本展开。然而，恢复出来的文本并不等于可用的文本。VLM 可以逐字转录图像中的文字，却仍然无法据此回答问题；而如果把它们自己转录的文字反馈给它们，其答题表现几乎与直接基于原始文本时一样好。我们将这种差异称为“读-用差距”。识别与使用视觉文本对分辨率的要求不同：Qwen3-VL-8B 的识别能力在字符高度为 15 像素时即趋于饱和，而使用能力要到 24 像素才能跟上；并且将模型从 2B 扩展到 32B 提升了识别能力，却没有缩小这一差距。把证据用文字写出来可以消除这一差距：具备思考能力的 VLM 会在思考过程中复述证据，而且它在没有看到问题的情况下写出的转录文本，就能恢复思考所带来的大部分增益。在一项预注册的留出测试中，该差距可以预测八个 VLM 从“自己的文字”相比“像素”所能获得的收益大小。
tldr: 该论文发现视觉语言模型存在“读-用差距”——即使能逐字转录图像中的文本也无法据此答题，而把自己的转录文本反馈给自己即可近乎完全恢复答题能力，且识别与使用视觉文本在分辨率要求和模型规模扩展上表现不同。
en_tdlr: VLMs exhibit a "read-use gap": they can transcribe visual text word-for-word yet still fail to answer from it, while feeding back their own transcripts nearly closes the gap, and recognition and use differ in resolution requirements and scale.
